title: pvEqualizerFilter
body:
## pvEqualizerFilter

Applies a frequency-domain equalizer to signal columns of a table: each column is Fourier transformed, its spectrum multiplied by a piecewise-linear gain curve given in EqualizerPoints, and transformed back. Output ports: 0 the spectrum, 1 the filtered signal (Result), 2 the normalized spectrum; select one with {"node": id, "port": n}. Use it for band-pass or notch filtering of probe or sensor time series.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Rows are assumed to be equally spaced samples at SamplingFrequencyHz; irregular time steps give a wrong frequency axis.
- With fewer than two equalizer points the signal is not modified.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `EqualizerFilter`. Identity: `filters/EqualizerFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: tables (rows and columns) (vtkTable). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkTable"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AllColumns` | Use for all columns of table. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Array` | Specify the name of a scalar array which will be used to FFT. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `EqualizerPoints` | This property defines the interactive points of the equalizer. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `SamplingFrequencyHz` | Set sampling frequency of signal. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `SpectrumGaindB` | Specify a gain coefficient (in dB) to apply to the spectrum of the input signal. Used only for convenient viewing. | `{"maximum":50,"minimum":-50,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `-50` |

```json

  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvEqualizerFilter",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
